title: Garbage Disposers: Selection, Features, Septic Options, and Jam Clearing

summary: This Old House presents a practical primer on choosing and maintaining a garbage disposer. The video compares models by horsepower, insulation, and features such as auto-reverse anti-jamming and batch-feed operation; it notes a septic-system option with an enzymatic additive. It explains the internal grinding mechanism (splash guard, collar, stainless-steel grinding wheel and teeth), how waste travels to the discharge, and common jam culprits (coins, jewelry, and stringy foods). The host demonstrates jam-clearing methods, including using the built-in reset button and an included Allen wrench, and surveys additional tools (extractor, tongs, broomsticks) for freeing a jam—emphasizing safety and not placing hands inside the unit.
